div.div:
Simplify README and create comprehensive configuration guide
- Streamline README from 377 to 267 lines (29% reduction) - Create detailed docs/configuration.md guide - Remove min_blast_identity references from config_template.yaml - Condense introduction, pipeline modules, and output structure - Maintain all essential information while improving readability - Separate technical configuration details into dedicated guide

Fix multi-sample BAM processing in exon repair module
- Add proper BAM merging, sorting, and indexing for multiple samples - Replace single-sample bug (bam_files[0]) with full multi-sample support - Disable BLAST identity filter to match original workflow - Resolves issue where only first sample was processed in exon repair
